en.description:
SpellFlare turns spelling practice into an adventure your kids will actually want to play. Designed for Grades 1-7,  
  SpellFlare speaks words aloud and lets children spell them using voice recognition or a kid-friendly custom keyboard 
  — no autocorrect, no shortcuts, just real spelling practice.                                                         
                                                                                                                       
  HOW IT WORKS                                                                                                         
  1. Listen — Hear the word spoken clearly, plus example sentences for context                                         
  2. Spell — Say the letters out loud or type them on the custom keyboard                                              
  3. Celebrate — Earn coins, unlock achievements, and watch confetti fly!                                              
                                                                                                                       
  50 LEVELS PER GRADE                                                                                                  
  Words are carefully curated for each grade level, from simple sight words in Grade 1 to spelling bee competition     
  words in Grade 7. Every child learns at their own pace with no time pressure.                                        
                                                                                                                       
  COINS, SHOP & REWARDS                                                                                                
  Earn coins for every level — more coins for fewer mistakes! Spend them on fun bee skins, background themes, and      
  celebration effects. Daily check-ins award bonus coins and build streaks.                                            
                                                                                                                       
  30+ ACHIEVEMENTS                                                                                                     
  From "Buzzing Beginner" to "Master of the Hive," kids earn achievements across skill, streaks, and grade completion  
  categories in Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary rarities — with Game Center support.                                 
                                                                                                                       
  FAMILY-FRIENDLY PROFILES                                                                                             
  Up to 4 player profiles on one device. Each child gets their own progress, coins, achievements, and avatar. Siblings 
  share the app — not their scores.                                                                                    
                                                                                                                       
  iPHONE & APPLE WATCH                                                                                                 
  Practice on iPhone at home or Apple Watch on the go. Progress syncs automatically between devices.                   
                                                
  BUILT FOR KIDS, TRUSTED BY PARENTS
  - No ads during gameplay — ever
  - No accounts, logins, or data collection
  - No external links or social media
  - Parent gate before any purchase
  - All data stays on your device

  WHAT'S INCLUDED
  - 350 levels across 7 grades
  - 10 words per level with sentence context
  - Voice spelling with phonetic letter recognition
  - Custom keyboard with no autocorrect
  - 16 avatar choices per profile                                                                
  - 15 shop items: bee skins, themes, effects
  - Daily check-in streaks with bonus coins
  - Monthly rotating achievements
  - Multiple voice options
  - Apple Watch companion app
en.releaseNotes: Minor bug fixes related to notifications
en.subtitle: Spelling bee practice

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
What’s new in this version:
 - Apple Watch support for quick spelling practice
 - Words spoken and used in full sentences
 - Coins and rewards for completing levels
 - Fun animations that celebrate progress
Designed to make spelling practice engaging, educational, and rewarding for kids.

- Multiple player profiles — up to 4 kids on one device                                                              
  - Coin shop with 15 cosmetic items: bee skins, themes, and celebration effects                                       
  - 30+ achievements with Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary rarities                                                   
  - Daily check-in system with streak tracking and bonus coins                                                         
  - Custom spelling keyboard — no autocorrect, kid-friendly layout                                                     
  - Grade 3-7 completion achievements                                                                                  
  - Monthly rotating achievements                                                                                      
  - Game Center integration                                                                                            
  - Avatar picker with 16 emoji choices                                                                                
  - Updated landing page and UI improvements

What's New                                                                    
                                                                               
  v5.2 — Stay in the Game
  Never miss a moment with push notifications! Get alerts when you drop in the rankings, when your competition is ending, and when you've won a reward. Tap any notification to jump straight to your leaderboard.                        
                                                                                
  v5.1 — Compete with Friends                                                  
  SpellFlare goes social! Challenge friends to private spelling competitions or jump into public matchmaking. Climb the leaderboard, earn coins for top finishes, and view player profiles to see how you stack up. Invite friends with a shareable code and compete for up to 7 days.
Minor bug fixes related to notifications
